why_not_one_block_off: PRINTED NAME. The chosen corridor is lettered vertically 'AVENUE S 1/2' inside its own roadway on BOTH sheets, and both plates print '70' in that roadway. WIDTH AND REPEATED READS. Sheet 82 block-face lines, read on all three block rows: 36TH-37TH 2074.5/2284.2, 37TH-38TH 2082.5/2292.5, 38TH-39TH 2084.5/2293.5 -> centres 2179.4, 2187.5, 2189.0, mean 2185.3. Sheet 90: 39TH-40TH 70.0/277.8, 40TH-41ST 67.8/276.3, 41ST-42ND 70.9/279.6 -> centres 173.9, 172.1, 175.3, mean 173.8. Faces are 207-210 px apart on both, i.e. the printed 70 ft (~212 px), not a ~20 ft alley. On sheet 90 the roadway is fully drawn - its west face at ~70 is a real lot line well inside the plate neat line at 42 - only the block west of it lies off-plate. ADDRESS RUNS. Sheet 82, along 37TH ST: west of the line '2518 2520 2522 2524' (2500 block), east of it '2602 2604 2606 2608 2610 2612 | 2614 2616 2618 ...' (2600 block). Sheet 90, along 40TH ST: the block immediately east of the line reads '2602 2604 2606 2608 2610 2612 | 2614 2616 2618 2620 2622 2624' and '2601 2603 ... 2623' - the same 2600 block. On both sheets the corridor is the west boundary of the 2600 run. THE AVENUE'S OWN FRONTAGE NUMBERS. Sheet 82 reads 3718-3728 even / 3717-3731 odd (37TH-38TH block of Ave S 1/2) and 3804-3824 even / 3803-3823 odd (38TH-39TH block); sheet 90 reads 4003-4025 odd (40TH-41ST block) and 4103-4123 odd (41ST-42ND block). Sheet 82 covers 36TH-39TH and sheet 90 covers 39TH-42ND, so 37xx, 38xx, 40xx, 41xx are consecutive blocks of one continuous Avenue S 1/2 address sequence running west. CITY BLOCK NUMBERS AGREE. Avenue S 1/2 bisects the Ave S - Ave T outlot column on both plates: outlot 161 (35TH-37TH) and 160 (37TH-39TH) on sheet 82, outlot 159 (39TH-41ST) and 158 (41ST-43RD) on sheet 90 - one continuous column 161-160-159-158 running west, with the N.E./N.W. quarters west of the line and the S.E./S.W. quarters east of it on BOTH sheets. ONE BLOCK WEST is excluded: that corridor is Avenue S (sheet 82 faces 1074.5/1281.4 and 1087.6/1294.6) and it carries the 2400/2500 change - along 37TH ST '2418 2420 2422 2424' / '2417 2419 2421 2423' west of it and '2502 2504 2506 2508 2510 2512' / '2501 2503 ... 2511' east of it. Avenue S is also not on sheet 90 at all: sheet 90's key map lists only S 1/2, T, T 1/2, and its western limit IS Avenue S 1/2. ONE BLOCK EAST is excluded: that corridor is Avenue T (sheet 90 faces 1064.1/1271.8, 1063.0/1273.3, 1068.1/1275.1 -> centres 1168.0, 1168.2, 1171.6, mean 1169.3; '70' printed in the roadway, frontage 3902/3904 even and 3901/3903 odd) and it carries the 2600/2700 change - along 39TH ST '...2621 2623' west of it and '2701 2703 2705 2707 2709 2711 | 2713 ... 2721' east of it. Avenue T bounds the EAST end of the 2600 run, so the west boundary of that run cannot be Avenue T. THE NEAR-EQUAL-NATIVE-X TRAP IS SEVERE ON THIS PAIR AND IS EXPLICITLY REJECTED. The two plates are framed TWO avenue-blocks apart (sheet 82 covers R 1/2 - T, sheet 90 covers S 1/2 - T 1/2; key-map rectangles start at x=4130 and x=4405). Sheet 82's Ave S 1/2 (2185.3) sits within ~13 px of sheet 90's platted Ave T 1/2 line (~2175, marked 'Av T 1/2' in sheet 90's top and bottom margins and never opened across outlots 184/183), and sheet 82's Ave S (1178.0) sits within ~9 px of sheet 90's Ave T (1169.3). Matching on native x - or on current mosaic proximity - would therefore have produced a clean-looking TWO-BLOCK error. The true offset is about -2011 px. CANDIDATES REJECTED. None of the six proposed candidates is the avenue: sheet 82's 576/1586/2596 and sheet 90's 768/1764/2761 sit in block interiors on the ~999 px lattice. The values reported here are ruler-read avenue centres, not candidates. CROSS-CHECK. Two independently measured corridors give the same sheet82->sheet90 x offset: Ave S 1/2 west faces -2010.9 and Ave T west faces -2007.9 (spread 3.0 px), against ~1007 px for a one-block error.
